coverage: Every G1 SDK builder creates immutable AST-v1 syntax without importing an engine or invoking producers.
36 shared Rust/Python AST cases compare exact canonical bytes and effective-policy digests. 239 structural cases include core node shapes and the additive capability.
Complete three-valued truth tables and root null-policy metrics; age 0/199 pass, -1/200/null violate the full expression, and empty row/key checks pass while row_count > 0 fails.
Null differs from NaN; NaN comparisons are false except not_equals; negative zero equals zero; membership nulls match only explicit null.
Exact primary-key tuples preserve component boundaries, case/Unicode spelling and integer/decimal/timestamp precision. Null-key rows are counted once outside grouping; all duplicate-group rows count.
The canonical [1,2,2,null] key fixture yields null_key_rows=1, duplicate_groups=1, duplicate_group_rows=2, violating_rows=3.
Schema preflight distinguishes deliberate exists/has_type conditions from missing columns and incompatible operands; unsupported key types fail even before empty/null data is considered.
Native Polars streaming regression materializes 1,024,000,000 logical bytes with 238,206,976-byte worker peak RSS through the new capability.
